title: Principal
description: Who did something (contract 03, C-03.1 to C-03.4). Carried on every write the hub accepts or relays and on every record the hub keeps about an action. writer_class keeps the six classes of web-chat 0.9's resolveWriter exactly (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/domain/writers.js, the THE CLASSES comment and resolveWriter), with null for an actor that is not a surface writer. Ids only: never an email, a display name or a path.

user.description: The account responsible: a user (usr_) or a service user (svc_, Home is svc_home). null when no account is known: a person at the machine's own browser, a daemon-local writer, or the hub's own job.

machine.description: The machine whose credential vouches for the actor: set for anything a connector reports or performs; null for a person or key authenticated at the hub.

chat.description: The chat whose daemon the writer lives in (claude, service, driver, pane, or a local browser user), or the acting agent's own chat for an agent acting by grant through the hub; null or absent otherwise.

session.description: The credential instance that was checked: a user session (ses_), a surface session (srf_), an API key (key_), a connector session (cxs_), an agent token (agt_), or cc:<uuid> for the Claude Code session id a daemon reports. null when nothing was checked.

writer_class.description: web-chat 0.9's writer class (lib/server/domain/writers.js): remote for a person or key acting through the hub, user only for a person at the machine's own browser, claude, service, driver, pane as the daemon resolves them. null for the hub's and the connector's own actions.

owner.description: The 0.9 owner string of a writer the daemon verified: claude (Claude's writer token) or service:<name> (a service child's token, or a driver's lease, whose owner is always service:<component name>, lib/server/domain/writers.js isLeasableOwner). Reported only when verified is true and verified_by is daemon (C-03.1); an unverified writer's owner is whatever a tokenless caller declared (writers.js declaredWriter) and is not reported. Absent or null otherwise.

verified.description: true only when a credential for this exact principal was checked by the tier named in verified_by (C-03.3). Enforced rules key only on true.

verified_by.description: Who checked the credential: hub (a user session, surface session, API key, agent token or machine credential) or daemon (Claude's writer token, a service child's token, a driver's lease). null when verified is false.

via.description: How the action entered the system: shell (desktop shell, including the framed chat origin), phone (phone app), notification (a Web Push notification action), api (an API key), mcp (an MCP server over the hub API: Home's with an API key, or another chat's agent with an agent token), scheduler (a queued message the hub released for its sender), connector (reported or performed by a machine's connector), hub (the hub's own job).

oneOf.description: An account's MCP server (Home's) holding an API key.
Another chat's agent acting by grant, holding an agent token (contract 10).

allOf.description: C-03.1: a daemon reports owner only for a writer it verified.
